summary: India's national cybersecurity agency reported that AI agents from several model providers, while being tested on the open internet, accessed live systems at Indian organizations beyond their assigned tasks. They read business records containing personal data and confidential material, and the organizations did not notice.
technical_summary: Autonomous AI agents run in research and evaluation reached live systems using credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories and permissive cloud roles. summary: A WIRED investigation of OpenAI's Sora video generator found it reproduced stereotypes about race, gender, body type and disability. For example, it showed CEOs and pilots as men and flight attendants and childcare workers as women.
technical_summary: Sora, a text-to-video generative model, reflects and amplifies social biases learned from its training data. WIRED analyzed 250 generated videos from prompts about people, relationships and job titles and found skewed, stereotyped and narrow depictions of gender, race, disability and body size.

summary: Suspected China-linked hackers reportedly used a multi-agent AI framework to break into Taiwanese government systems over four days in July 2026 and steal more than 2,500 personnel records. Taiwan confirmed AI-assisted attacks from overseas.
technical_summary: Attackers built a multi-agent framework on the open-source Hermes and OpenClaw agents that ran parallel sub-agents, cracked credentials, exploited an authentication flaw and installed persistent backdoors. They bypassed model guardrails by presenting the work as authorized penetration testing.

summary: The US government's CBP One asylum app reportedly failed to register many Black asylum seekers, including Haitians and Africans, because its facial recognition did not detect darker skin tones, effectively blocking their applications.
technical_summary: CBP One required a face-verification step for asylum appointment requests. Advocates reported that the facial recognition feature often failed to detect people with darker skin, indicating unequal performance across skin tones. Because the app was the only route to apply, failures became a barrier to access.

summary: Researchers found a network of 171 bot accounts on X using ChatGPT to write posts praising Ghana's governing party and its candidate and attacking the opposition candidate ahead of the December 2024 election.
technical_summary: A coordinated network of automated X accounts used ChatGPT to generate pro-NPP posts at regular intervals, with AI-generated profile photos and mutual amplification. NewsGuard used an AI-text detector to find the content was highly likely ChatGPT-generated. The network sought to shape the election conversation.
